blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Mayor Akmad “Mitra” Ampatuan Sr. of Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, on Monday challenged his nephew to surrender and squarely face the charges in connection with a rocket-propelled grenade (RPG) attack in January this year. “My son, come out and surrender; face the cases against you… We will see you in court. We’ll not face each other on the battlefield,” the mayor said in a press conference. He was referring to Mayor Andal “Xyril” Ampatuan V of Datu Unsay, Maguindanao del Sur, who, along with 11 others, were charged with terrorism. Presiding Judge Alberto Quinto of Iligan City […]...
